title: ETH Podcast is going on a creative break and will reappear with a new concept next year. Time for host and co-producer Jennifer Khakshouri from Audiobande to look back and revisit two of her first podcast guests:
main_content:
ETH Podcast is going on a creative break and will reappear with a new concept next year. Time for host and co-producer Jennifer Khakshouri from Audiobande to look back and revisit two of her first podcast guests:

Agnieszka Rozniak and Hanno Kappen. What do the former students do today? How did their time at ETH shape them, what have they learned for life when they look back, and what advice would they give to young ETH students?
summary: ETH Podcast is going on a creative break and will reappear with a new concept next year....
